Graduate Admissions
Tips for Getting Started
Admissions to University of Arizona Aerospace and Mechanical Engineering graduate programs are handled through the U of A Graduate College. Information provided here is summarized. Please see the Graduate College pages specified below and the AME graduate handbooks for detailed information.
Apply Now
Interested in a snapshot of the U of A AME grad programs? Check out these materials:
Aerospace Engineering Graduate Programs (PDF)
Mechanical Engineering Graduate Programs (PDF)
Aerospace & Mechanical Engineering Accelerated Master’s Programs (PDF)
Aerospace & Mechanical Engineering Graduate Research Labs Brochure (PDF)
Submission Reminders
Remember the following with your application as a decision cannot be entered until all requirements are met and all materials are submitted:
Official transcript, ensuring if you are from India that it includes official sum of total marks and marks obtained for each semester
GRE general test scores – preferably with quantitative and analytical writing sections in the top 25th percentile
For international students, TOEFL or IELTS scores dated no more than two years before the term of application
TOFL minimum score of 79 for the Internet exam and 550 for the paper exam
IELTS composite score of at least 7 with no subject area falling below 6
Three letters of recommendation
Personal statement, including research experience
Requirements Guidelines
Bachelor of Science in aerospace, mechanical or nuclear engineering preferred
Degrees from other engineering, mathematics and physical sciences programs typically admitted provisionally, subject to completion of recommended undergraduate courses
Grade average of B+ or better in all previous university-level academic work, particularly for advanced mathematics and engineering courses
Application Codes
GRE Institution Code for the University of Arizona: 4832
Major Field Code for aerospace engineering: 1601
Major Field Code for mechanical engineering: 1502
Application Deadlines
Admission With Funding Consideration
Fall: Jan. 1
Spring: June 1
Admission Without Funding Consideration
Domestic Students
Fall: June 1
Spring: Oct. 1
International Students
Fall: Jan. 1
Spring: June 1
